items.issue: 30 of the new parametrized cases fail on Python 3.14, and CI's `tools` matrix runs 3.14 on both ubuntu and macOS. `_fail_metadata` injects errors by patching `Path.stat`. On 3.14, `Path.exists()` and `Path.is_dir()` call `os.path.exists`/`os.path.isdir` and never reach `Path.stat`, so the patched error never fires in `plan`. Reproduced with `uv run --python 3.14 pytest tests/tools/backup`: 30 failed, 485 passed. The failures are all of `test_runner_isolates_metadata_failures_and_preserves_independent_instances` and all of `test_runner_propagates_the_original_fatal_metadata_error`. The same command on 3.11 passes 515/515, and the gate ran only 3.13. Fix: inject the error through a seam that works on every version, for example wrap `TarArchive.plan` to raise for the blocked labels, since the runner's per-instance isolation is what these tests check.

items.issue: `_cleanup_tar_process` sends terminate and kill only to the tar pid, although `start_new_session=True` gives tar its own process group (tar_archive.py:502, tar_archive.py:527-533). On Linux, GNU tar `-z` forks gzip, which inherits the stderr pipe. So the post-kill `process.communicate()` with no timeout (tar_archive.py:533) waits for gzip to exit, not the bounded wait promised in the PRD Risks section. `os.killpg` would close this gap
